User confirmed Book2 distances are sensor mounting positions; origin, height and angle are unspecified.
0.85 is displayed as 85%. Holes detected is retained separately and is not the accuracy denominator.
All records in Sampling, Latency and Position, including Week 5, are generated examples, not observations.
Retain a two-lane MVP through Week 9 for comparability. This is an assumed scenario, not verified firmware history.
Five 60-second runs per sensor per week. Fixed 45 ms alternating triggers; increasing valid-reading yield.
Assumed mean valid fractions for Weeks 5-9: 85%, 89%, 92%, 94%, 97%; random trial variation included.
30 synthetic HTTP request/response RTTs per week, timed at the computer to the access-point ESP32.
Assumed base RTT medians 27, 24, 23, 21, 19 ms; lognormal variation plus occasional delays.
RTT is not one-way delay, Wi-Fi join time, motion-to-screen delay, or a measured remote-node-to-PC delay.
Five trials per setup/week; 100 attempts spread across six holes. Holes detected counts holes with at least one correct response.
Same player movements across six holes and the same room assumed; valid yield and accuracy are separate trials.
Hypothetical better mounting, calibration and filtering motivate the trend; none is claimed as completed work.
Fixed PRNG seed 48234559. Trial values are fixed; calculated metrics and summaries use Excel formulas.
Synthetic data for examples, planning and charts. Replace with real logs before describing demo performance as measured.
Empty duplicate connection-time headings and the incomplete Ac heading in Book2 contain no results.
